title: The hypertrophy series: why & how to prioritize work capacity for muscle building
summary: NH explains why work capacity matters for hypertrophy: tonnage accumulation requires enduring many consecutive sets and exercises within effective intensity windows. If your ability to return to baseline or your cardiovascular system limits you, build work capacity, which makes building muscle easier. The transcript is garbled, so this note relies on the description.
claims: Tonnage accumulation means multiplying sets and reps within relevant intensity windows until fatigue stops you lifting weights near your absolute intensity
In practice many lifters can't endure consecutive exercises because their ability to return to baseline is low or their cardiovascular system can't handle lower body movements
The solution in both cases is building work capacity, which makes building muscle easier, and more muscle in turn raises work capacity
